column1: # BHF containerised sweep corpus — 2 small, real, pinned projects per language.
# Columns (TAB-separated): lang  id  git_url  rev  subpath  extra_bhf_flags
# subpath / extra may be "-" for none. This is the DEFAULT manifest; override
# with BHF_SWEEP_MANIFEST. Revs are pinned full commit SHAs for reproducibility.
# Targets are small, single-purpose parsers/decoders (prime fuzz targets) with a
# PUBLIC, auto-harnessable entry point. Each project has been verified to build,
# harness, and fuzz inside the container (see docs/validation).
